raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The source started sending separate 'REVERSAL' rows (15 of them) that point to the reversed transaction through orig_txn_id, but those originals still carry status POSTED. silver_transactions keeps every POSTED row and drops the REVERSAL rows, so reversed transactions still count toward the gold totals and inflate the recent days. This change was not in the change notes, and the fix assumes each REVERSAL is a full reversal, since all amounts in the profile are positive.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions rv WHERE rv.status = 'REVERSAL' AND rv.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND rv.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
